# Snake Lite 1.2

Snake Lite 1.2 is out. The board is bigger: 12 x 12 cells instead of 10 x 10. Each food still adds 1 point, and the game now runs at 8 ticks per second.

You steer with W, A, S, D, as before. The best score is still kept in `scores.json`, which `saveBest` in `src/scores.js` writes. To check that everything works, run `npm test`.
